summary: Identified six distinct operating sponsors with qualifying closed single-asset Retail acquisitions in Phoenix between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31: Birch Point 6, Birch Park 5, Birch Square 4, Birch Park 3, Birch Square 2, and Birch Square 1 (via SPV Birch Square 7). Records with brokers/managers, portfolio totals, out-of-window dates, non-Phoenix markets, unqualified roles, or insufficiently verified contacts were excluded. A prospect CSV with citations has been created (artifacts/prospects-v2.csv).
limitations: Some entities (e.g., Birch Square 19) failed the contact recency test due to older verification dates; no newer qualifying updates were provided.

One sponsor (Birch Square 1 Capital) had multiple related records (parent plus SPV); we resolved to the operating parent and used the most recent qualifying transaction, which may reflect a different asset than other duplicates.
Unsigned draft and post-cutoff updates were ignored by rule; if future executed updates alter sizes or roles, rankings could change.
Only the supplied extracts and updates were used; no external corroboration or additional contacts were considered.
